pandas.DataFrame.to_sql

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Write tabular data to a SQL table. Use if_exists to control what happens when the table is already present.

Call syntax

DataFrame.to_sql(…) Full signature
DataFrame.to_sql(
    name,
    con,
    *,
    schema=None,
    if_exists='fail',
    index=True,
    index_label=None,
    chunksize=None,
    dtype=None,
    method=None,
)
